name: gzdoom
description: GZDoom mod development rule pack — catches config precedence issues, stale asset references, debug logging in release paths, and dangerous render backend overrides.

rules.message: r_drawvoxels 1 forces voxel rendering — may cause performance issues on integrated GPUs
rules.suggestion: Remove this override or make it opt-in via CVAR info with user consent

rules.message: set r_drawvoxels 1 in console script forces voxel rendering at runtime
rules.suggestion: Use a CVAR with user_default instead of hard-setting it

rules.message: vid_preferbackend 1 forces OpenGL — may break on systems that prefer Vulkan or Vulkan is the only option
rules.suggestion: Let the user choose their renderer, or use vid_preferbackend 0 (auto)

rules.message: set vid_preferbackend in console script overrides user renderer preference at runtime
rules.suggestion: Remove this line — renderer choice should be user-controlled

rules.message: Console.Log() call found — verify this is not in a release/hot path
rules.suggestion: Wrap in #ifdef DEBUG or use a CVAR-gated debug flag

rules.message: A_Log() call — will print to console at runtime, verify this is intentional
rules.suggestion: Remove for release builds or gate behind a debug CVAR

rules.message: Hardcoded WAD/PK3 asset reference — verify the file exists in the mod tree
rules.suggestion: Use relative paths and validate with the asset reference scanner

rules.message: set <cvar> <value> in config file — this overrides user settings at load time
rules.suggestion: Use defaultvalue or user_default in CVARINFO instead of hard-setting in config

rules.message: CVAR defaultvalue set — verify this doesn't conflict with other CVARINFO files
rules.suggestion: Check for duplicate CVAR definitions across all .cvarinfo files in the mod

rules.message: Command-line flag in config file (+flag) — this is a launch argument, not a config setting
rules.suggestion: Move to launch script (.bat) or use 'set' syntax in config

rules.message: Hardcoded gzdoom.exe path in launch script — may not work on other systems
rules.suggestion: Use a variable or detect GZDoom install location

rules.message: -file flag references a .wad — verify load order and file existence
rules.suggestion: Use -file with .pk3/.ipk3 for modern mods, verify the file exists

rules.message: -config flag overrides the user's default config — verify this is intentional for release
rules.suggestion: Remove -config for release builds, or document why a custom config is required

rules.message: MAPINFO map entry with lookup — verify the lookup string exists in LANGUAGE
rules.suggestion: Check that the lookup key is defined in your LANGUAGE lump

rules.message: ZScript class inheriting from Actor — verify this isn't a duplicate of an existing class
rules.suggestion: Check for class name collisions across all .zs/.zscript files in the mod

rules.message: ZScript Default block — verify flag values don't conflict with parent class defaults
rules.suggestion: Check parent class defaults for conflicting flags

rules.message: ZScript States block — verify state labels don't conflict with parent class
rules.suggestion: Check parent class state labels for collisions

rules.message: KEYCONF addkeysection — verify all referenced menu names exist
rules.suggestion: Check that all menu names referenced here are defined in MENUDEF

rules.message: CVARINFO user CVAR definition — verify the CVAR name doesn't conflict with engine CVARs
rules.suggestion: Prefix custom CVARs with your mod name (e.g. MyMod_DebugMode)

rules.message: CVARINFO server CVAR — this is networked, verify it's needed for multiplayer sync
rules.suggestion: Only use server CVARs if the value must be synchronized to all clients
